title: Clock configuration assembly
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $c$ be a configuration of $W$ on $x$. Given a clock state $s$, a buffer tape $\tau$, a buffer-head position $z\in\mathbb Z$, work-tape contents $kt$, work-head positions $kh$, and an output word $out$, form a configuration of the clock machine with state $s$, input-head position inherited from $c$, and output $out$. Its work tapes, in order, are $kt$, the buffer tape $\tau$, and the work tapes of $c$; their head positions are $kh$, $z$, and the work-head positions of $c$.
